name: proofable-mcp
description: Let AI agents do real work with their own ID, limits you set, and a receipt for every job.

interface.shortDescription: Context and control for any AI.
interface.longDescription: Check whether someone is already verified before you ask them again. Give each AI agent its own ID, owned by you, with limits on what it can do and spend. Hand it work, watch it run, and switch it off from anywhere. Every job leaves a receipt you can check. Sign in once with your Proofable account.
defaultPrompt: Check what my agents are allowed to do.
Reuse a proof I already have instead of verifying again.
Show my Proofable profile and what it can prove.
